comparison.objective: Open a connector lever, insert bare wire to the insulation, and close the lever; candidate adjusts and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Lever actuation and depth-controlled wire insertion versus hex-key loosening, fine collar rotation, counterholding, torque-limited locking, and cycle testing.
comparison.success_condition: Copper correctly inserted and clamped without insulation in the clamp versus two safe stops with no bottoming, rebound, overload, or drift.
comparison.reason: Both have an unlock-adjust/insert-lock sequence, but their core tested abilities—wire termination versus response-based damper commissioning—are meaningfully different. Specs are empty; insertion-depth and clamp-force tolerances are not numeric.
